sources.title: PayPal AI Hackathon official rules (representative Devpost rules page)

prize.text: Published per hackathon. Open on 2026-11-01: PayPal AI $67,500; Kiroween $100,000; Meta VR Start $1,000,000; Codegeist $120,000; UGREEN $46,000; Codex x TwitchCon $25,000
prize.quote: PayPal AI Hackathon ... $67,500 in prizes ... 11 days left | Kiroween 2026 ... $100,000 in prizes | Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 ... $1,000,000 in prizes

freeEntry.text: Free to enter: standard Devpost rules state no purchase or payment is necessary.
freeEntry.quote: NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE OR PAYMENT WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING.

deadline.text: Per hackathon. Example: PayPal AI Hackathon submissions close 2026-11-12 12:00 pm Pacific; winners around 2026-12-21
deadline.quote: Submission Period: Thursday Oct 1, 2026 (9:15 am Pacific Time) - Thursday Nov 12, 2026 (12:00 pm Pacific Time)

eligibility.text: Individuals at or above the age of majority where they reside, teams, and organizations. Excluded: residents of Brazil, Quebec, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and other US-sanctioned countries; sponsor/administrator employees and judges.
eligibility.quote: The Hackathon IS open to: Individuals who are at least the age of majority where they reside as of the time of entry

aiPolicy.text: AI tools are explicitly allowed on AI hackathons; each rules page governs what must be built and disclosed. Example rules permit any AI tool as long as the sponsor integration is central.
aiPolicy.quote: Any AI tool works, as long as PayPal integration is central to the project.

payout.quote: Payment mechanics are not described on the listing or the rules sections read in this pass.

summary: Best verified source of large, genuinely free-to-enter cash prizes: 14,220 hackathons indexed with six-figure pools live on 2026-11-01. Prize money is real cash; effort is a working software project judged within days.
flags: Prize amounts are per-hackathon; the listing page shows pool totals, not per-place awards.
Many listings are student or invite-only events; check the rules page for each.
The ledger's 'currently $10,000 to $685,000 per hackathon' range is stale: the largest pool listed on 2026-11-01 was $1,000,000.
attribution: Additional live-verification supplied by parallel session be1d2210 from dashboard/data/verification/verified.json (pages read 2026-11-01).
